name: Specific provider and time with alternate acceptance

metadata.notes: Manually designed test scenario for healthcare AI phone-agent evaluation. Observations are preliminary notes for later review, not confirmed bugs or formal bug reports.

goal: Test whether the healthcare agent correctly separates requested provider/time availability from a confirmed booking, and accurately reflects when the patient accepts an alternative instead of the original request.

patient.name: Hannah Brooks
patient.accepted_alternative: Thursday at 11:00 AM with Dr. Kim, or another available clinician if needed

conversation_beats: Ask specifically for Dr. Kim on Wednesday at 9:00 AM for a skin rash on your forearm.
If told that slot is unavailable, ask what else is open with Dr. Kim.
Accept Thursday at 11:00 AM as an alternative if offered, or the closest available option.
Clarify that accepting an alternative is not the same as confirming the original Wednesday 9 AM request.
Provide your name and date of birth when asked.
Ask whether the appointment is requested, held, or actually booked.
